verses.greek: Ἡ φιλαδελφία μενέτω.
verses.literal: the Brotherly love should abide.
verses.dgt: Let brotherly love remain.

verses.greek: τῆς φιλοξενίας μὴ ἐπιλανθάνεσθε, διὰ ταύτης γὰρ ἔλαθόν τινες ξενίσαντες ἀγγέλους.
verses.literal: the Of hospitality not do forget through this for unawares some have entertained angels.
verses.dgt: Do not neglect hospitality, for through it some unknowingly entertained angels.

verses.greek: μιμνῄσκεσθε τῶν δεσμίων ὡς συνδεδεμένοι, τῶν κακουχουμένων ὡς καὶ αὐτοὶ ὄντες ἐν σώματι.
verses.literal: do remember the prisoners as bound with them and those being mistreated as also yourselves being in the body.
verses.dgt: Remember the prisoners as though imprisoned with them, and those being mistreated as though you yourselves were also in the body.

verses.greek: τίμιος ὁ γάμος ἐν πᾶσιν καὶ ἡ κοίτη ἀμίαντος, πόρνους γὰρ καὶ μοιχοὺς κρινεῖ ὁ θεός.
verses.literal: Honorable let the marriage be in all and the marriage bed undefiled the sexually immoral for and adulterers will judge the God.
verses.dgt: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and the marriage bed undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

verses.greek: ἀφιλάργυρος ὁ τρόπος· ἀρκούμενοι τοῖς παροῦσιν· αὐτὸς γὰρ εἴρηκεν· Οὐ μή σε ἀνῶ οὐδʼ οὐ μή σε ἐγκαταλίπω·
verses.literal: Let be without covetousness the your manner of life being satisfied with the present He Himself for has said: Certainly not you shall I leave nor certainly not you shall I forsake
verses.dgt: Let your way of life be free from love of money, being content with what you have; for he himself has said, “I will certainly not leave you, nor will I ever forsake you.”

verses.greek: ὥστε θαρροῦντας ἡμᾶς λέγειν· Κύριος ἐμοὶ βοηθός, οὐ φοβηθήσομαι· τί ποιήσει μοι ἄνθρωπος;
verses.literal: So are confident we to say: The Lord is my helper not I will be afraid what will do to me man?
verses.dgt: So we can say confidently, “The Lord is my helper; I will not fear. What will a human being do to me?”

verses.greek: Μνημονεύετε τῶν ἡγουμένων ὑμῶν, οἵτινες ἐλάλησαν ὑμῖν τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ, ὧν ἀναθεωροῦντες τὴν ἔκβασιν τῆς ἀναστροφῆς μιμεῖσθε τὴν πίστιν.
verses.literal: do remember those leading you who spoke to you the word of the God of whom considering the outcome of their way of life do imitate the faith.
verses.dgt: Remember your leaders, who spoke the word of God to you. Considering the outcome of their way of life, imitate their faith.

verses.greek: Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ἐχθὲς καὶ σήμερον ὁ αὐτός, καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας.
verses.literal: Jesus Christ yesterday and today is the same and to the ages.
verses.dgt: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

verses.greek: διδαχαῖς ποικίλαις καὶ ξέναις μὴ παραφέρεσθε· καλὸν γὰρ χάριτι βεβαιοῦσθαι τὴν καρδίαν, οὐ βρώμασιν, ἐν οἷς οὐκ ὠφελήθησαν οἱ περιπατοῦντες.
verses.literal: by teachings various and strange not do be taken away it is good for by grace to be strengthened for the heart not by foods in which not they profited those being devoted.
verses.dgt: Do not be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace, not by foods, from which those who walk in them were not benefited.

verses.greek: ἔχομεν θυσιαστήριον ἐξ οὗ φαγεῖν οὐκ ἔχουσιν ἐξουσίαν οἱ τῇ σκηνῇ λατρεύοντες.
verses.literal: We have an altar from which to eat not they have authority those in the tabernacle serving.
verses.dgt: We have an altar from which those who serve the tabernacle have no right to eat.

verses.greek: ὧν γὰρ εἰσφέρεται ζῴων τὸ αἷμα περὶ ἁμαρτίας εἰς τὰ ἅγια διὰ τοῦ ἀρχιερέως, τούτων τὰ σώματα κατακαίεται ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς·
verses.literal: Whose for is brought of animals the blood as sacrifices for sin into the Holy Places through the high priest of those the bodies are burned outside the camp.
verses.dgt: For the bodies of those animals whose blood is brought into the holy places by the high priest for sin are burned outside the camp.

verses.greek: διὸ καὶ Ἰησοῦς, ἵνα ἁγιάσῃ διὰ τοῦ ἰδίου αἵματος τὸν λαόν, ἔξω τῆς πύλης ἔπαθεν.
verses.literal: Therefore also Jesus so that he may sanctify through the own blood the people outside the gate suffered.
verses.dgt: Therefore Jesus also suffered outside the gate, so that he might sanctify the people through his own blood.

verses.greek: τοίνυν ἐξερχώμεθα πρὸς αὐτὸν ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς, τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν αὐτοῦ φέροντες.
verses.literal: Therefore we may go forth to Him outside the camp the reproach of Him bearing
verses.dgt: So then let us go out to him outside the camp, bearing his reproach.

verses.greek: οὐ γὰρ ἔχομεν ὧδε μένουσαν πόλιν, ἀλλὰ τὴν μέλλουσαν ἐπιζητοῦμεν·
verses.literal: Not for we have here an abiding city but the coming one we are seeking for.
verses.dgt: For here we do not have a lasting city, but we seek the one to come.

verses.greek: διʼ αὐτοῦ οὖν ἀναφέρωμεν θυσίαν αἰνέσεως διὰ παντὸς τῷ θεῷ, τοῦτʼ ἔστιν καρπὸν χειλέων ὁμολογούντων τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: Through Him then we may offer the sacrifice of praise through all times the to God That is the fruit of the lips confessing the name of Him.
verses.dgt: Through him, therefore, let us continually offer a sacrifice of praise to God, that is, the fruit of lips confessing his name.

verses.greek: τῆς δὲ εὐποιΐας καὶ κοινωνίας μὴ ἐπιλανθάνεσθε, τοιαύταις γὰρ θυσίαις εὐαρεστεῖται ὁ θεός.
verses.literal: the And the good and of sharing not do be forgetful with such for sacrifices is well pleased the God.
verses.dgt: And do not neglect doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.

verses.greek: Πείθεσθε τοῖς ἡγουμένοις ὑμῶν καὶ ὑπείκετε, αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἀγρυπνοῦσιν ὑπὲρ τῶν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν ὡς λόγον ἀποδώσοντες, ἵνα μετὰ χαρᾶς τοῦτο ποιῶσιν καὶ μὴ στενάζοντες, ἀλυσιτελὲς γὰρ ὑμῖν τοῦτο.
verses.literal: do obey to those leading you and do be submissive they themselves for watch over the souls of you as an account to be giving that with joy this they may do and not groaning unprofitable indeed for you is this.
verses.dgt: Obey your leaders and yield to them, for they keep watch over your souls as those who will give an account, so that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

verses.greek: Προσεύχεσθε περὶ ἡμῶν, πειθόμεθα γὰρ ὅτι καλὴν συνείδησιν ἔχομεν, ἐν πᾶσιν καλῶς θέλοντες ἀναστρέφεσθαι.
verses.literal: do pray for us we are assured for that a good conscience we have in all things well desiring to conduct ourselves.
verses.dgt: Pray for us, for we are convinced that we have a good conscience, desiring to conduct ourselves honorably in all things.

verses.greek: περισσοτέρως δὲ παρακαλῶ τοῦτο ποιῆσαι ἵνα τάχιον ἀποκατασταθῶ ὑμῖν.
verses.literal: More abundantly now I exhort you this to do so that quicker I may be restored to you.
verses.dgt: And I urge you all the more to do this so that I may be restored to you sooner.

verses.greek: Ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης, ὁ ἀναγαγὼν ἐκ νεκρῶν τὸν ποιμένα τῶν προβάτων τὸν μέγαν ἐν αἵματι διαθήκης αἰωνίου, τὸν κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν,
verses.literal: May the now God the of peace the having brought out from the dead the Shepherd of the sheep the great by the blood of the covenant eternal the Lord of us Jesus
verses.dgt: Now may the God of peace, who brought up from the dead the great Shepherd of the sheep, our Lord Jesus, by the blood of an eternal covenant,

verses.greek: καταρτίσαι ὑμᾶς ἐν παντὶ ἀγαθῷ εἰς τὸ ποιῆσαι τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ, ποιῶν ἐν ἡμῖν τὸ εὐάρεστον ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας· ἀμήν.
verses.literal: would he equip you in everything good in order the to do the will of Him working in us that which is well pleasing before Him through Jesus Christ to whom be the glory to the ages Amen.
verses.dgt: equip you with every good thing to do his will, doing in us what is pleasing before him through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever. Amen.

verses.greek: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, ἀνέχεσθε τοῦ λόγου τῆς παρακλήσεως, καὶ γὰρ διὰ βραχέων ἐπέστειλα ὑμῖν.
verses.literal: I exhort now you brothers do bear with the word the of exhortation only for in few words I have written to you.
verses.dgt: And I urge you, brothers and sisters, bear with this word of encouragement, for indeed I have written to you briefly.

verses.greek: γινώσκετε τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν Τιμόθεον ἀπολελυμένον, μεθʼ οὗ ἐὰν τάχιον ἔρχηται ὄψομαι ὑμᾶς.
verses.literal: You know the brother of us Timothy released with whom if quicker he shall come I will see you.
verses.dgt: Know that our brother Timothy has been released, with whom, if he comes soon, I will see you.

verses.greek: ἀσπάσασθε πάντας τοὺς ἡγουμένους ὑμῶν καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους. ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς οἱ ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰταλίας.
verses.literal: do greet all those leading you and all the saints. Greet you those from the Italy.
verses.dgt: Greet all your leaders and all the saints. Those from Italy greet you.

verses.greek: ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν.
verses.literal: the Grace be with all of you.
verses.dgt: Grace be with all of you.
